theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Myths From Facts
body: Myth: Only wealthy people invest. Truth: Mutual funds welcome investors of all income levels, starting small is perfectly fine.
caption: Investing isn't reserved for the rich. Mutual funds democratize market access, allowing anyone to start their investment journey with modest amounts. Knowledge and consistency matter more than initial capital. #MutualFunds #InvestingMyths #MFBasics #FinancialLiteracy #InvestSmartInvestEarly
